mapper.select: SELECT WA.* FROM WORK_EFFORT_ANALYSIS WA INNER JOIN WORK_EFFORT_TYPE WET ON WA.WORK_EFFORT_TYPE_ID = WET.WORK_EFFORT_TYPE_ID WHERE WET.PARENT_TYPE_ID = #{context} AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM USER_LOGIN_SECURITY_GROUP ULSG INNER JOIN SECURITY_GROUP_PERMISSION SGP ON ULSG.GROUP_ID = SGP.GROUP_ID AND SGP.PERMISSION_ID LIKE CONCAT(#{permission}, 'MGR_ADMIN') WHERE ULSG.USER_LOGIN_ID = #{userLoginId} AND WA.AVAILABILITY_ID = 'AVAIL_INTERNAL' ) OR WA.AVAILABILITY_ID = 'AVAIL_PUBLIC' ) ORDER BY WA.REFERENCE_DATE DESC, WA.WORK_EFFORT_ANALYSIS_ID ASC

SELECT
FROM WORK_EFFORT_ANALYSIS WA INNER JOIN WORK_EFFORT_TYPE_TYPE WTT ON WTT.WORK_EFFORT_TYPE_ID_ROOT = WA.WORK_EFFORT_TYPE_ID AND WTT.SEQUENCE_NUM > 1 INNER JOIN WORK_EFFORT WE ON WE.WORK_EFFORT_TYPE_ID = WTT.WORK_EFFORT_TYPE_ID_FROM INNER JOIN PARTY P ON P.PARTY_ID = WE.ORG_UNIT_ID INNER JOIN PARTY_PARENT_ROLE PPR ON PPR.PARTY_ID = P.PARTY_ID AND PPR.ROLE_TYPE_ID = 'ORGANIZATION_UNIT' WHERE WA.WORK_EFFORT_ANALYSIS_ID = #{analysisId} AND WE.WORK_EFFORT_ID = #{workEffortId}

select
, ,
from WORK_EFFORT_ANALYSIS wa inner join WORK_EFFORT_TYPE_TYPE wtt on wtt.WORK_EFFORT_TYPE_ID_ROOT = wa.WORK_EFFORT_TYPE_ID and wtt.SEQUENCE_NUM = 1 inner join WORK_EFFORT we on we.WORK_EFFORT_TYPE_ID = wtt.WORK_EFFORT_TYPE_ID_FROM and we.WORK_EFFORT_REVISION_ID is null inner join WORK_EFFORT_TYPE wt on wt.WORK_EFFORT_TYPE_ID = we.WORK_EFFORT_TYPE_ID inner join WORK_EFFORT ra on ra.WORK_EFFORT_ID = we.WORK_EFFORT_PARENT_ID inner join WORK_EFFORT_TYPE rat on rat.WORK_EFFORT_TYPE_ID = ra.WORK_EFFORT_TYPE_ID inner join CUSTOM_TIME_PERIOD tp on tp.PERIOD_TYPE_ID = rat.PERIOD_TYPE_ID and tp.FROM_DATE <= wa.REFERENCE_DATE and tp.THRU_DATE >= wa.REFERENCE_DATE inner join USER_LOGIN ul on ul.PARTY_ID = ul.PARTY_ID inner join USER_LOGIN_SECURITY_GROUP ulsg on ul.USER_LOGIN_ID = ulsg.USER_LOGIN_ID inner join SECURITY_GROUP_PERMISSION spv on spv.GROUP_ID = ulsg.GROUP_ID left join PARTY_RELATIONSHIP pro on pro.PARTY_ID_FROM = we.ORG_UNIT_ID and pro.PARTY_RELATIONSHIP_TYPE_ID in ('ORG_RESPONSIBLE', 'ORG_DELEGATE') and (pro.THRU_DATE is null or pro.THRU_DATE >= wa.REFERENCE_DATE) and spv.PERMISSION_ID like concat(#{permission}, 'ORG_ADMIN') and pro.PARTY_ID_TO = ul.PARTY_ID where wa.WORK_EFFORT_ANALYSIS_ID = #{analysisId} and we.ORGANIZATION_ID = #{organizationId} and ( wa.EXCLUDE_VALIDITY = 'Y' or wa.EXCLUDE_VALIDITY = 'N' and ( we.ESTIMATED_START_DATE <= wa.REFERENCE_DATE and we.ESTIMATED_COMPLETION_DATE >= tp.FROM_DATE ) or wa.EXCLUDE_VALIDITY = 'A' and ( we.ESTIMATED_START_DATE <= tp.THRU_DATE and we.ESTIMATED_COMPLETION_DATE >= tp.FROM_DATE ) ) and ulsg.USER_LOGIN_ID = #{userLoginId} and ( spv.PERMISSION_ID like CONCAT(#{permission}, 'MGR_ADMIN') or spv.PERMISSION_ID like CONCAT(#{permission}, 'ORG_ADMIN') and pro.PARTY_ID_TO is not null and pro.PARTY_ID_TO = ul.PARTY_ID )

select CTP.CUSTOM_TIME_PERIOD_CODE as CTP_CUSTOM_TIME_PERIOD_CODE, CTP.CUSTOM_TIME_PERIOD_CODE_LANG as CTP_CUSTOM_TIME_PERIOD_CODE_LANG, ATE.AMOUNT as ATE_AMOUNT, GFT.DESCRIPTION as GFT_DESCRIPTION, GFT.DESCRIPTION_LANG as GFT_DESCRIPTION_LANG from WORK_EFFORT WE inner join WORK_EFFORT_TYPE WET on WET.WORK_EFFORT_TYPE_ID = WE.WORK_EFFORT_TYPE_ID inner join WORK_EFFORT_MEASURE WEM on WEM.WORK_EFFORT_ID = WE.WORK_EFFORT_ID inner join ACCTG_TRANS_ENTRY ATE on ATE.VOUCHER_REF = WEM.WORK_EFFORT_MEASURE_ID and ATE.GL_ACCOUNT_ID = 'SCORE' inner join GL_FISCAL_TYPE GFT on GFT.GL_FISCAL_TYPE_ID = ATE.GL_FISCAL_TYPE_ID inner join ACCTG_TRANS AT on AT.ACCTG_TRANS_ID = ATE.ACCTG_TRANS_ID and AT.WORK_EFFORT_REVISION_ID is null inner join CUSTOM_TIME_PERIOD CTP on CTP.PERIOD_TYPE_ID = WET.PERIOD_TYPE_ID and CTP.THRU_DATE = AT.TRANSACTION_DATE where WE.WORK_EFFORT_ID = #{workEffortId} order by CTP.FROM_DATE asc

select GA.ACCOUNT_NAME as GA_ACCOUNT_NAME, GA.ACCOUNT_NAME_LANG as GA_ACCOUNT_NAME_LANG, ATE.AMOUNT as ATE_AMOUNT, GFT.DESCRIPTION as GFT_DESCRIPTION, GFT.DESCRIPTION_LANG as GFT_DESCRIPTION_LANG from WORK_EFFORT WE inner join WORK_EFFORT_TYPE WET on WET.WORK_EFFORT_TYPE_ID = WE.WORK_EFFORT_TYPE_ID inner join WORK_EFFORT_MEASURE WEM on WEM.WORK_EFFORT_ID = WE.WORK_EFFORT_ID inner join ACCTG_TRANS_ENTRY ATE on ATE.VOUCHER_REF = WEM.WORK_EFFORT_MEASURE_ID and ATE.GL_ACCOUNT_ID = 'SCOREKPI' inner join GL_FISCAL_TYPE GFT on GFT.GL_FISCAL_TYPE_ID = ATE.GL_FISCAL_TYPE_ID inner join ACCTG_TRANS AT on AT.ACCTG_TRANS_ID = ATE.ACCTG_TRANS_ID and AT.WORK_EFFORT_REVISION_ID is null inner join GL_ACCOUNT GA on GA.GL_ACCOUNT_ID = WEM.GL_ACCOUNT_ID where WE.WORK_EFFORT_ID = #{workEffortId} and AT.TRANSACTION_DATE = #{analysisRefDate} order by GA.FROM_DATE asc

select CTP.CUSTOM_TIME_PERIOD_CODE as CTP_CUSTOM_TIME_PERIOD_CODE, CTP.CUSTOM_TIME_PERIOD_CODE_LANG as CTP_CUSTOM_TIME_PERIOD_CODE_LANG, ATE.AMOUNT as ATE_AMOUNT, GA.ACCOUNT_NAME as GA_ACCOUNT_NAME, GA.ACCOUNT_NAME_LANG as GA_ACCOUNT_NAME_LANG from WORK_EFFORT WE inner join WORK_EFFORT_TYPE WET on WET.WORK_EFFORT_TYPE_ID = WE.WORK_EFFORT_TYPE_ID inner join WORK_EFFORT_MEASURE WEM on WEM.WORK_EFFORT_ID = WE.WORK_EFFORT_ID inner join ACCTG_TRANS_ENTRY ATE on ATE.VOUCHER_REF = WEM.WORK_EFFORT_MEASURE_ID and ATE.GL_ACCOUNT_ID = 'SCOREKPI' inner join GL_ACCOUNT GA on GA.GL_ACCOUNT_ID = WEM.GL_ACCOUNT_ID inner join ACCTG_TRANS AT on AT.ACCTG_TRANS_ID = ATE.ACCTG_TRANS_ID and AT.WORK_EFFORT_REVISION_ID is null inner join CUSTOM_TIME_PERIOD CTP on CTP.PERIOD_TYPE_ID = WET.PERIOD_TYPE_ID and CTP.THRU_DATE = AT.TRANSACTION_DATE where WE.WORK_EFFORT_ID = #{workEffortId} and ATE.GL_FISCAL_TYPE_ID = #{glFiscalTypeId} order by CTP.FROM_DATE asc

select CTP.CUSTOM_TIME_PERIOD_CODE as CTP_CUSTOM_TIME_PERIOD_CODE, CTP.CUSTOM_TIME_PERIOD_CODE_LANG as CTP_CUSTOM_TIME_PERIOD_CODE_LANG, ATE.AMOUNT as ATE_AMOUNT, GFT.DESCRIPTION as GFT_DESCRIPTION, GFT.DESCRIPTION_LANG as GFT_DESCRIPTION_LANG from WORK_EFFORT_MEASURE WEM inner join GL_ACCOUNT GA on GL.GL_ACCOUNT_ID = WEM.GL_ACCOUNT_ID inner join ACCTG_TRANS_ENTRY ATE on ATE.VOUCHER_REF = WEM.WORK_EFFORT_MEASURE_ID and ATE.GL_ACCOUNT_ID = 'SCOREKPI' inner join GL_FISCAL_TYPE GFT on GFT.GL_FISCAL_TYPE_ID = ATE.GL_FISCAL_TYPE_ID inner join ACCTG_TRANS AT on AT.ACCTG_TRANS_ID = ATE.ACCTG_TRANS_ID and AT.WORK_EFFORT_REVISION_ID is null inner join CUSTOM_TIME_PERIOD CTP on CTP.PERIOD_TYPE_ID = GA.PERIOD_TYPE_ID and CTP.THRU_DATE = AT.TRANSACTION_DATE where WEM.WORK_EFFORT_MEASURE_ID = #{workEffortMeasureId} order by CTP.FROM_DATE asc

select wea.*, wet.work_effort_type_id as WET_work_effort_type_id, wet.description as WET_description, wet.description_lang as WET_description_lang, wet2.work_effort_type_id as WET2_work_effort_type_id, wet2.description as WET2_description, wet2.description_lang as WET2_description_lang
from work_effort_analysis wea join work_effort_type wet on wet.work_effort_type_id = wea.work_effort_type_id join work_effort_type wet2 on wet2.work_effort_type_id = wet.parent_type_id where wea.work_effort_analysis_id = #{workEffortAnalysisId}
